newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 13.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 13.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average ended down 98.81 points, or 1.54 percent, at 6,303.71 on Thursday in hectic trading as the market was hit by a second consecutive day of heavy losses.
* Indonesia is likely to produce 1.7 million motorcycles in 1997, an increase of around 25 percent on the 1.36 million units expected to be built this year, the Bisnis Indonesia daily reported.
* The Jakarta Composite Index rose 1.33 points, or 0.21 percent, to end at 627.90 on Thursday after Telkom continued to rise in late trading.
* On Friday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,353.15/53.55 against the dollar in early trading after opening at 2,354.00/54.25.
* Branta Mulia on confirmation that Du Pont of the United States had expressed interest in taking a minority stake in the tyre products manufacturer.
* Tambang Timah on reports that the state-owned integrated tin miner had expressed interest in participating in the massive Busang gold find in East Kalimantan.
* Telkom on reports the government will sell 388 million shares in the telecommunications firm.
* Plastic packaging manufacturer Dynaplast on the announcement of a rights issue and an expected production capacity expansion.
* Shipping firm Berlian Laju Tanker on a news report the company had set a target for earnings per share of 300 rupiah in 1997 and was looking to buy 20 percent of Malaysian Merchant Marine Berhad.
